format: CriptoVersus Arena Pressure sprite pack v2 — full-ring 100% illumination
notes: Sprites are cut from the user-provided transparent original, not AI-redrawn.
Canvas renderer: use file x/y positions; source origin is 0,0.
Positive hub angle means clockwise inclination toward the cyan/right side.
Orange is left (#ff9100), cyan is right (#18d8d2).
Light and wobble transforms act independently.

animation.wobble_logic: Small alternating tilt +/-6deg driven by rope tension; not by pressure winner.
animation.hub_logic: Center orb rotates to LEFT for left win (negative angle), RIGHT for right win (positive angle).
animation.pressure_logic: Set individual segment alpha per side, e.g. 39% orange vs 61% cyan. Fade and sequence LEDs; light segments may be tinted but are already colored.
animation.renderer_note: Use the pre-rendered wobble frames for the wheel shell. Add segmented light overlays with the same wheel rotation; draw hub on top of the shell, with its independent tilt and winner color.

full_ring_v2.description: Two team colors always cover the ENTIRE 18-section wheel. Never pressure/100 * 9 on each half.
full_ring_v2.order: clockwise from bottom through LEFT 9 sectors, then RIGHT 9 sectors
full_ring_v2.fractional_segment: Use angular canvas clip for exact boundary, not alpha fade on entire segment.
